# Dracula's Cave

> The man with the cape

Dracula's Cave is the personal site of DiscoDracula — indie games, software and music, plus a long-running blog. The game and software pages are the projects; the posts are the blog, newest first, with the full run in the archive.

## Site

- [Home](https://draculascave.co/): Dracula's Cave — developers of the Lion Quest series of games, The Wizard of Gloss, CAPITALISM, M1 and more.
- [Contact](https://draculascave.co/contact/): Contact Dracula's Cave — enquiries about our games, software and the blog.
- [Games](https://draculascave.co/games/): Games by Dracula's Cave — The Wizard of Gloss, the Lion Quest series, CAPITALISM, M1: A Death in the Desert and Animal Maker.
- [Newsletter](https://draculascave.co/newsletter-subscribe/): Sign up to the Dracula's Cave newsletter for news about our games and software.
- [Privacy Policy](https://draculascave.co/privacy/): The Dracula's Cave privacy policy — how we handle data across the website, blog, games and software.
- [Software](https://draculascave.co/software/): AudioTheory software by Dracula's Cave — Guitars, Piano Keys and Grids: interactive music theory reference tools.

## Games

- [Animal Maker](https://draculascave.co/games/animal-maker/): Animal Maker — create your own character to use across multiple games made by Dracula's Cave, including Lion Quest, CAPITALISM and Sloth Tales.
- [CAPITALISM](https://draculascave.co/games/capitalism/): CAPITALISM The action board game for one player (2022) — a real-time board game / card game hybrid where your goal is to become a millionaire. Out now on Steam.
- [Lion Quest Infinity](https://draculascave.co/games/lion-quest-infinity/): Lion Quest Infinity (2021) — Jethro the Lion and friends steal a magic grandfather clock. The sequel to Lion Quest with 2D, 2.5D, 3D and even 4D levels. Out now on Steam.
- [Lion Quest](https://draculascave.co/games/lion-quest/): Lion Quest (2016) — take Jethro the Lion on a magical journey traversing space and time to prevent the imminent collapse of the universe. Out now on Steam.
- [M1: A Death in the Desert](https://draculascave.co/games/m1/): M1: A Death in the Desert (2017) — the original visual novel game by Dracula's Cave. Three names, three bullets — how far will you go to discover the truth?
- [Sloth Tales](https://draculascave.co/games/sloth-tales/): Sloth Tales (2020) — Jimmy the Sloth embarks on his own adventure. Think Lion Quest, but with a Sloth. On Steam and the App Store.
- [The Wizard of Gloss](https://draculascave.co/games/the-wizard-of-gloss/): The Wizard of Gloss — a PSX-style metroidvania game with horror elements from Dracula's Cave. Explore a sprawling, occult waterpark. Coming 202X.

## Software

- [CLInt](https://draculascave.co/software/clint/): CLInt is a free full-screen launcher for games and videos on Windows. Fast, controller-first and open source — he scans your Steam library, plays your videos and remembers where you stopped.
- [Remote Helper](https://draculascave.co/software/remote-helper/): Remote Helper turns your iPhone or iPad into a wireless keyboard for your PC or Mac. Everything travels over your own Wi-Fi — no cloud, no accounts, no nonsense.
